Done. All 7 test cases in `bottle_song_test.go` pass, and I didn't touch the test files or add any new files.

**How it works** (`bottle_song.go`):
- `Recite(startBottles, takeDown)` loops from `startBottles` down `takeDown` verses, emitting the four lyric lines per verse and inserting a blank line between verses (not after the last one).
- `numberWords` maps counts 0–10 to their words, with zero rendered as "no" per the spec.
- `bottleWord` handles the singular/plural switch: "one green bottle" vs "no green bottles".
- `title` capitalizes the count word only at the start of a verse line, keeping it lowercase in "There'll be nine green bottles...".

I deliberately didn't reuse the `Title` helper from the test file — it only exists during test compilation, so referencing it would break a plain `go build`. The first test run caught the capitalization subtlety (the count word is lowercase in the fourth line), which the fix above resolves.
